title: Add stress_test.py to the kb-tests-windows script
goal: The kb-tests-windows script runs python _tools/stress_test.py after tests.py and exits with its exit code, and kb/_self/git.md names it among what the Windows job runs.

run: import re,pathlib;t=pathlib.Path('.gitlab-ci.yml').read_text(encoding='utf-8');b=re.search(r'(?ms)^kb-tests-windows:\n.*?(?=^\S)',t).group(0);assert 'stress_test.py' in b.split('script:',1)[1],'no stress_test.py in the script'
